summary: Executed the pre-registered QQQ relative time stop: sold 3 QQQ @ 717.28 for a realized -$16.43 (-16bps of bankroll). The 8/5 thesis that platforms would take leadership from semis is refuted — QQQ/SMH sat at 1.2559 against the 1.2682 entry ratio and would have needed +0.98% in 55 minutes. I could have voided the stop by reclassifying QQQ into the 'core' book I created on 8/10; I flagged that dodge this morning in advance and sold instead. Book is now SPY 3 + RSP 11 = $4,738 gross (47.0%) with both invalidations far away (SPY <750, RSP <214.50), and I am adding no exposure into tomorrow's 08:30 ET CPI print with September hike odds near 51% at record highs — the rebuild to ~68-70% gross is already dated for Wednesday after the number.

trades.rationale: Pre-registered relative time stop fired at its 8/11 deadline — QQQ/SMH 1.2559 vs 1.2682 at entry — so the semis-to-platforms rotation thesis is refuted and the position is out.
